proof:
Source: Fact 1(b) of the parent proof, direction “at least ℓ integer coordinates ⇒ x ∈ L_n” (used for conclusion (i) in Step 3).

1. By definition, for F = (z, α) ∈ LatticeFaceIndex (m+1) d (d := m + 1 + ℓ), i.e. z ∈ ℤ^d and α : Fin (m+1) ↪o Fin d an order embedding (SimonMultiIndex (m+1) d), latticeFace 1 F = {y : for every i, (i ∈ range α ⇒ 1·z_i ≤ y_i ≤ 1·(z_i + 1)) and (i ∉ range α ⇒ y_i = 1·z_i)}.
2. Let I be the given set, |I| = ℓ, with x_i = k_i ∈ ℤ for i ∈ I. The complement Iᶜ := {1,…,d} ∖ I has d − ℓ = m + 1 elements. Let α : Fin (m+1) ↪o Fin d be its increasing enumeration (Finset.orderEmbOfFin Iᶜ), so that range α = Iᶜ (Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin).
3. Put z_i := ⌊x_i⌋ for every i. For i ∈ I we have x_i = k_i, hence z_i = ⌊k_i⌋ = k_i = x_i.
4. If i ∈ range α, then z_i = ⌊x_i⌋ ≤ x_i < ⌊x_i⌋ + 1 = z_i + 1. If i ∉ range α, then i ∈ I, so x_i = z_i. Hence x ∈ latticeFace 1 (z, α) ⊆ ⋃_F latticeFace 1 F. ∎
key_steps: α := increasing enumeration (Finset.orderEmbOfFin) of the (m+1)-element complement of I, so range α = Iᶜ.
z_i := ⌊x_i⌋, which equals x_i for i ∈ I.
